scope: All four-run point/interval forecasts and evaluation labels are portable; 216 selected member arrays support raw CRPS recomputation for each run HGB-weather and C HGB-no-weather/RF-weather. Other methods full raw CRPS was independently recomputed from locally sealed full members and is not all included here. No full fitted models or original country energy/GFS caches included. This is a compact interim research evidence package, not a full clean-machine training release.
frozen_models_available_locally: See each original results/* model_seal.json and *_heads.joblib. Models remain unmodified.

inherited_baseline_members.note: R3 joint_original and cube_weather_wind_solar match original joint_original and weather_wind_solar respectively; three-branch identities verified independently.
